verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt file at documentation.identity.entrust.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) that describes the platform. Excerpts from that file summarize the integration flow and API migration, and doc pages are served as .md files, which suits agent consumption. Missing for 10: no evidence of an llms-full.txt or complete content index, no first-party guidance on pointing agents at the docs, and no independent hands-on reports of agents using them.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://documentation.identity.entrust.com/llms.txt # Entrust Identity Verification Documentation
